params.body:
A new page block, **Video**, for a film with sound in the page flow: a title, an optional short line, the mp4 and a still. Made for the production film at the foot of the Hoet home page; the site renders it in hoet-eyewear PR #78.

It is not the hero. The hero loops silently and fetches itself; this block waits for the visitor to press play. The still decides the size of the player on the site, so the hint asks for the film's own proportions.

## What changed

- `videoBlock` object type, registered in the schema and offered in the page block list.
- Preview shows the internal name or the Dutch title with the still.

## Verification

`tsc --noEmit` passes; prettier passes on the new file and `index.ts` (`page.ts` was already failing the check before this change, untouched). The vitest suite needs `SANITY_READ_TOKEN` and runs in CI.

Deploy by hand with `npm run deploy` after merging.
params.title: Add the Video page block
